authorization.scope: One fresh, separately registered controlled recipient message-content study using three frozen allocation contexts, four recipient arms, and 24 maximum physical inference requests; official DeepSeek deepseek-flash alias only through the documented https://api.deepseek.com/beta/chat/completions strict function-calling endpoint; temperature 0, thinking disabled, maximum 128 output tokens; no Qwen, provider fallback, Monitor calls, training, custom transport, retries, replacements, resumption, or resampling; USD 0.05 peak-rate cost cap; 90-minute wall-clock cap; stop on transport, model/fingerprint, source/prompt hash, privacy, project-budget, expiry, or wall-clock failure; expires 2026-10-22T18:00:00Z.

competing_explanations: Independent incentive-driven choice: with the target visible the shared bonus elicits the target; with the target hidden, the recipient follows its own score preference and does not track the assigned message mapping.
Message-content response: under the same shared reward and hidden target, the recipient ballot follows whichever mapping the controlled peer message names, including the counterfactual decoy.
Serving or prompt instability: exact-prompt repeats disagree or the direction varies across the three fixed contexts, leaving a small message contrast inconclusive.
hypothesis: Across the three frozen allocation contexts, conditional on a passing visible/no-message control (at least 4/6 target ballots), exact token equality between true- and false-mapping message inputs, and stable repeats, at least two contexts will have both hidden true-message repeats select the hidden rewarded target and both false-message repeats select the matched decoy, while neither hidden no-message repeat selects target or decoy. This finite output pattern supports a recipient response to controlled peer-message content in these prompts; it does not identify spontaneous coordination, intent, or population effects.

prior_evidence.claim: M1: 9/15 joint target choices only in the bundled private-target-reward-plus-chat condition and 0/15 in each other condition; this is a finite association, not a communication-causal estimate.
M3: proposal and masked ballots match 8/8 eligible contexts; neutral and no-delivery each change 3/8 in the same contexts, with target-history and fixed-peer settlement confounds.
The 804-request scripted-recipient study failed its delivered-fact action positive control (0/20) and had downstream truncation; it does not validate a communication mechanism.
M4: evidence-view labels changed on a fixed corpus and identical historical/current requests often returned different labels; this motivates stability checks but is not agent-action evidence.

The separate 36-assignment visibility study stopped at 13 attempts, with one complete context at ceiling, incomplete disclosure/control gates, and a token mismatch; it is inconclusive and not resumed.
The literature review and prior evidence synthesis identify a missing within-context controlled message-content contrast, while limiting any resulting claim to finite recipient action response.

protocol.ambiguous_gate: All results not meeting the finite supported or finite weakening criteria are INCONCLUSIVE. A failed visible/no-message control, target hits at ceiling in hidden/no-message, materially unstable exact-prompt repeats, non-parity, or incomplete coverage cannot support a content effect or equivalence claim.
protocol.analysis_plan: Independently reconstruct prompts and request hashes from frozen source, schedule, and code; reparse each saved raw response using the pinned strict tool schema; reconcile all assigned, started, terminal, assessable, and failed rows and usage. Calculate exact target and decoy mapping hits per context/arm and repeat disagreement. No p-values, population inference, latent-collusion labels, or intent inference.
protocol.denominator: 24 assigned physical requests: 3 contexts x 4 arms x 2 exact-prompt repeats. Each assigned row is attempted at most once; attempted, completed, assessable, failed/invalid, and unattempted counts are all reported.
protocol.failure_gate: No retry, replacement, resumption, or resampling. Continue independent scheduled rows after a response-format or invalid-action failure while retaining that row. Stop dispatch on transport/network failure, provider/model/fingerprint drift, source or request-hash mismatch, privacy failure, budget cap, authorization expiry, or 90-minute limit. A full assigned schedule with failed output remains in analysis.
held_constant: source payoff matrix and legal allocations within context
shared +20 reward for both active participants on the exact target allocation
recipient role and peer identity within context
decision stage and no prior recipient history
message template, message length, and all prompt text between true and false message arms
model alias, strict tool schema, decoding settings, endpoint, sequential schedule, and output validation
protocol.intervention: Four stateless recipient arms per context: visible target/no message; hidden target/no message; hidden target/standard message stating the actual target; hidden target/the identical standard message with only the allocation permuted to a preregistered near-equal-score decoy. Each arm has two exact-prompt repeats. The true/false message prompts must have exact pinned-token parity and differ only in the task mapping in the message.
protocol.primary_outcome: Exact ballot agreement with the allocation mapping stated in each hidden-target message, compared within context between true-target and counterfactual-decoy messages and against hidden/no-message. Report visible/no-message target control, all assigned denominators, and exact-repeat disagreements.
protocol.reproduction_command: python scripts/run_shared_target_message_content_v1.py --analyze (requires the protected local run directory; makes no model call)
protocol.runtime_identity: Official DeepSeek deepseek-flash API alias through https://api.deepseek.com/beta/chat/completions using strict function calling; temperature 0, thinking disabled, output cap 128. Record returned model and fingerprint and stop on any drift. The provider alias and fingerprint are not immutable weights.
protocol.sample_selection: Three contexts are selected output-independently from the hash-pinned M1 package matrix schedule, one from each target-regret stratum 6/12/18. Within each stratum choose the first source row with a different legal assignment within one public-welfare point of the target and strict +20 target-bonus dominance for active participants A and B. Use the fixed task-label permutations and A/B/A recipient roles in the frozen schedule.
protocol.success_gate: Finite supported message-response pattern requires at least 4/6 visible/no-message target ballots and, in at least two contexts, both hidden true-message repeats to choose the target, both hidden false-message repeats to choose the decoy, and neither hidden/no-message repeat to choose target or decoy. This is a fixed-context behavior result only.

research_question: Under a shared target reward, does changing only the allocation mapping stated by a peer message change a live LLM recipient's ballot when the target is hidden?
selection_rationale: The central unresolved causal question is whether a recipient's ballot follows peer-message information beyond independent choice under a shared incentive. Existing M1 bundles reward and chat, M3 retains target-information/history confounding, Recipient's scripted-cue control failed, and the visibility-v1 cycle stopped with only one complete ceiling context and a token mismatch. The three-arm content intervention plus two controls is the smallest design that directly changes message mapping while holding the task and shared reward fixed.
title: Shared target reward and peer-message content: a controlled recipient allocation intervention
